## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D3. This is audit backlog UX-29 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: Every screen, lightly · all roles · 375 to 1920.
Findings and reviewers: F-21 · reviewers B-11, B-18, C-05, C-11, C-16. Part 2 of 2 of audit backlog UX-29 (part 1 defined the tokens).
Rationale: 12 rendered font sizes against a scale of 7; bold used 250 times and medium once, so weight ranks nothing; paragraphs up to 1,160 px wide; settings inputs 1,100 px; the sm: step is 360 px, so small-screen column rules apply on phones and clip the registration stepper at 375.
Proposed UX behaviour: A codemod moves arbitrary font sizes (11, 12.5, 13.5, 15, 17, 22 px) to the nearest type token; body weight becomes 500; bold stays for headings and the one thing that identifies a row; numbers, vitals, times and amounts use tabular numerals. Fluid pages get the 1,600 px maximum, descriptions and hints the reading width (about 72 characters), settings forms the 768 px form width. sm:grid-cols-* becomes md: and each changed layout is checked at 375. The ratchet counts for arbitrary font sizes and sm:grid-cols fall to zero and their lint rules turn to error (queue display and print stay on the allow-list).
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/08-design-system-blueprint.md sections 2 and 5.
Components and tokens affected: No new component; uses the tokens of part 1.
Front end and back end split: Front end only.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the token ticket and the control-height codemod. Merges alone, like the first codemod. Timing: after the first pilot weeks, or before the first staff training session if the founder moves it there; never between training and the first two pilot weeks (arbitration ruling 6).
Clinical sign-off: Not required. Typed clinical text stays 16 px.
Effort and regression risk: M · Medium: every screen changes slightly; checked by capture comparison in English and Arabic.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) A new typeface or palette. (2) Layout redesign of any screen.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the 20 most-used screens at 1440, when rendered font sizes are measured, then only the nine token sizes appear (the queue display and print excepted)
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a list row, when it renders, then the identifying cell is bold and body text is weight 500
- [ ] **AC3.** Given 1920 px, when Today, the patient record and Settings render, then no paragraph is wider than about 72 characters and the page content is at most 1,600 px wide
- [ ] **AC4.** Given Register patient at 375 px, when the stepper renders, then no step label is clipped
- [ ] **AC5.** Given a feature file, when text-[13.5px] or sm:grid-cols-2 is added, then lint fails
- [ ] **AC6.** Given captures before and after in English and Arabic, when compared, then no text is truncated or overlapping, and axe finds no violation

## Test notes

- Metric check reusing the audit's font-size measure across the captured screens.
- J1 to J3 and feature suites green; capture comparison attached to the pull request.
